coordinate_system: identical to the REV-B environment: 1 unit = 1 m, Z up, right-handed, origin at the bridge deck start, +X along the corridor
method: per-member oriented bounding volumes, conservative by construction (every primitive contains its source member)

exclusion_reasons.DEFECT: surface detail inside its host member, not an obstacle
exclusion_reasons.secondary_detail: cable trays, conduit, brackets, downpipes - real but sub-100 mm; enable with include_services=True
exclusion_reasons.terrain_mesh: replaced by a ground half-space primitive
exclusion_reasons.water_surface: replaced by a water half-space primitive
exclusion_reasons.road_surface: coincident with the deck slab already present

checks.name: every box primitive matches its source bbox
all structural primitives inside the corridor
checks.detail: 60 m tolerance for members that straddle the boundary

checks.name: air draft preserved over the navigation channel
inspection bay between girders stays open
checks.detail: box-fitting the I-section must not close the bay

checks.name: road pier columns preserved with correct diameter
under-deck volume preserved for all six road sectors
metro viaduct reaches the collision asset
metro pier columns preserved as cylinders
